b2-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Wherever You Go
b2-14-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says he will miss you when you are away from Budapest. You promise to call him wherever you go.
b2-14-01.prompt: Promise Carlos that you will call him wherever you go.
cues: Say that you will call him
Say that it does not matter where you go
b2-14-01.target: Dondequiera que vaya, te voy a llamar.
b2-14-01.english: Wherever I go, I'm going to call you.
b2-14-01.canDo: I can say whoever, whichever and wherever with quienquiera que, cualquiera que and dondequiera que.

b2-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: An Expensive Trip
b2-14-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg says a trip she wants to take is too expensive. You tell her that however much she saves, the trip will still be expensive.
b2-14-02.prompt: Tell Meg that however much she saves, the trip stays expensive.
cues: Say that it makes no difference how much she saves
Say that the trip is still expensive
b2-14-02.target: Por más que ahorres, ese viaje va a seguir siendo caro.
b2-14-02.english: However much you save, that trip is going to stay expensive.
b2-14-02.canDo: I can say however much, however many with por más or por mucho + noun + que + subjunctive.

b2-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Whatever They Think
b2-14-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says people at the office criticise his plan and asks what to do. You tell him that whatever they think, the decision is his.
b2-14-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that whatever people think, he decides.
cues: Say that it makes no difference what they think
Say that the decision is his
b2-14-03.target: Opinen lo que opinen, tú decides.
b2-14-03.canDo: I can say sea quien sea, sea cual sea and sea lo que sea for whoever and whatever it is.

b2-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Everyone Is Welcome
b2-14-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks who can come to a party. You say that anyone who wants to come is welcome.
b2-14-04.prompt: Tell Meg that anyone who wants to come is welcome.
cues: Say that they must want to come
b2-14-04.target: Todo aquel que quiera venir es bienvenido.
b2-14-04.english: Anyone who wants to come is welcome.
b2-14-04.canDo: I can say everything that and everyone who with todo lo que, todos los que and todo aquel que.

b2-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Notice for the Building
b2-14-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks you to write a short notice for the neighbours of a building in Budapest. It asks them politely not to make noise after ten o'clock.
b2-14-05.prompt: Write the notice for the neighbours.
cues: Ask politely for no noise after ten
b2-14-05.target: Estimados vecinos: se ruega no hacer ruido después de las diez.
b2-14-05.english: Dear neighbours: please do not make noise after ten o'clock.
b2-14-05.canDo: I can read and write short notices with todo aquel que, cualquier persona que and se ruega.

b2-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rule for Late Arrivals
b2-14-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what the rule is for people who arrive late to a meeting. You say that anyone who arrives late must wait, whoever it is.
b2-14-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg the rule for people who arrive late.
cues: Say that it makes no difference who it is
b2-14-consolidation.target: Cualquiera que llegue tarde deberá esperar, sea quien sea.
b2-14-consolidation.english: Anyone who arrives late must wait, whoever it is.
b2-14-consolidation.canDo: I can say that it makes no difference who, which or where, in several ways.
